zh-CN.title: 关系与视觉细节升级
items: 吕洞宾、钟离权与何仙姑采用全新 48 帧动效，角色更稳定、动作更细腻
修复广场头像框显示为方形的问题，头像与边框轮廓更加统一
用户详情重新排版，好友可分别开启上线提醒与发言提醒

en.title: Refined profiles and visuals
items: Lu Dongbin, Zhongli Quan, and He Xiangu now use new, steadier 48-frame animations
Fixed square corners on framed avatars across the Square
Redesigned user profiles with separate online and post alerts for friends
